items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: We were playing at Palms Road House... And Maurice Decou Durante, he was a great huntsman also. And Walter Decou who was the piano player.

ctx.x: We were playing at Palms Road House and each night some guy would bring something that he had cooked or something like that. And the way old Big Eye Louis could fry rabbit. Boy, and he'd have the garlic all through it, you know. Oh, it was delicious.
And Maurice Decou Durante, he was a great huntsman also. And Walter Decou who was the piano player.
